What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Metal Balls for the Transfer Case Front Drive & Reduction Shafts
These are part of the Shifter Mechanism and Requires 3 of these Smaller Balls
I also stock the larger Ball that is also Required. (See T-Case Category in my eBay Store)

What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
